name: setup-manaflow-ai-lamina-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: Lamina, a layered, translucent desktop look, compact and balanced, on frosted glass. Theme files for color, glass, layers and proportions (Lamina, dark, the default; Lamina Light), settings for how panes separate, a threads sidebar grouped by folder and the chat's column, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for 8 point cards and one-point strokes in the chat, and --cmux-md-* tokens that draw the Markdown viewer the same way. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.themes/lamina-light.json:
// Lamina: a layered, translucent desktop look (compact and balanced, light). Pane and control corners 4 and 8,
// one-point strokes, no reveal effects, an accent mark on the selected row. Every key is a look key.
{
  "name": "Lamina Light",
  "description": "A layered, translucent desktop look: compact and balanced, light.",

  // Palette: layer color, ink, selection, accent.
  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  "colors": {"background": "#f3f3f3", "foreground": "#1b1b1b", "selection": "#cfe4f6", "accent": "#005fb8"},
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "appearance.highlightColor": "#cfe4f6",

  // Glass: how much of the desktop shows through the layers.
  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "frosted",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.9,
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.1,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": true,
  "appearance.inactiveWindowDim": 0.03,

  // Chrome: cards with a one-point stroke, a subtle tone in the title area.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "card-outlined",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "subtleTone",
  "appearance.titleAreaContrast": 0.8,
  "appearance.cornerFlush": "off",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "tabs",
  "focus.inactiveTabStyle": "tonal",

  // Layers: sidebar and docks lowest, title and tabs next, content on top.
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#eeeeee",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.78,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#f3f3f3",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 0.85,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#fbfbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#fbfbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#fbfbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.color": "#fbfbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.color": "#fbfbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#fbfbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.color": "#fbfbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.color": "#fbfbfb",
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.color": "#f3f3f3",
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.opacity": 0.85,
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.color": "#eeeeee",
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.opacity": 0.78,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#e0e0e0",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,

  // Panes: 8 point corners, one-point stroke.
  "layout.paneCornerRadius": 8,
  "layout.paneBorderWidth": 1,
  "layout.cornerPadding": 4,

  // Sidebar: compact rows, a one-point edge, the accent on the selected row.
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "sidebar.density": "compact",
  "sidebar.groupHeader.background": "glass",

  // Density and metrics.
  "appearance.density": "compact",
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 28,
  "appearance.metrics.titlebarHeight": 32,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 30,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.dividerThickness": 1,
  "appearance.fontSmoothing": "auto",

  // Type: the system face in the chat, a slightly smaller code scale.
  "agentPane.display.font.preset": "system",
  "agentPane.display.font.ui": "system-ui",
  "agentPane.display.font.size": 14,
  "agentPane.display.font.lineHeight": 1.5,
  "agentPane.display.code.scale": 0.9,

  // Status: work in progress shows as a thin ring in the accent.
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.size": 0.9,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.thickness": 1.5,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#005fb8",

  // Motion: short color changes, nothing slides in.
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 120,
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "easeOut"
}
